profile.headline: Quality Assurance Specialist
profile.summary:
I’m a dedicated and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer with over 10 years of experience in software testing, SDET work, game QA, and enterprise-level systems support. I specialize in delivering high-quality software through thorough manual and API testing, UAT, black box, and regression testing, with hands-on expertise using tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, and Backlog.

Throughout my career, I’ve worked on everything from mobile apps and enterprise platforms to AAA video games, always ensuring products meet the highest standards before release. My background also includes mentoring junior testers, owning test plans, and actively collaborating in Agile environments.

I hold a Bachelor’s in Information Technology and a Master’s in Business Administration, and I’m also a U.S. Air Force veteran with an active Secret Clearance, which speaks to my discipline, reliability, and leadership under pressure.

🔹 Skills: QA Testing | SDET | Jira | ADO | API Testing | UAT | Regression | Game QA | SQL | Manual Testing
🔹 Industries: Software, Gaming, E-commerce, Government Contracting
🔹 Tools: Jira, Azure DevOps, TestTrack Pro, Backlog

I’m passionate about quality, teamwork, and continuous learning—and I’m always open to new opportunities in QA, SDET, or automation roles.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Prepare detailed test cases and participate in application testing.
Support user acceptance testing by creating test cases, test plans, and tools to capture test results.
Perform manual application testing by running test cases. Capture and communicate test results.
Perform quality end-to-end testing on the system to ensure proper system functionality.
Perform other related duties as requested.

positions.title: System Support Analyst
positions.description:
•Principles and practices of enterprise level information systems as applied to a large and diversified public organization .
• Methods, materials, tools, and equipment used in PC and midrange computer networking, repairs, and operations.
•Principles and practices of PC & Mac operation, maintenance, and repair.
• Principles and techniques used in interacting with troubleshooting skills for PC & Mac users

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Ownership of multiple game areas and assist in directing other area owners
•	Review and provide feedback on test specifications and coverage plans for other STEs
•	Mentor other STEs and Test Associates
•	Ability to drive and evangelize one or more commonly used tools within the department
•	Present test reviews, process improvements, postmortems or new tools to the client
•	Strong knowledge of software testing standards, methodologies and conventions, and the product development cycle
•	Experience owning quality for multiple areas of shipped products
•	Knowledgeable of (JavaScript, VBScript, Perl Script or Windows batch files)
•	SQL, ASP, IIS, and/or HTML
•	Black Box Testing
•	API Testing
•	UAT Testing 
•	Used bug tracking programs Jira and ADO

positions.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
positions.description:
Draft assurance policies and procedures
Interpret and implement quality assurance standards
Evaluate adequacy of quality assurance standards
Devise sampling procedures and directions for recording and reporting quality data
Review the implementation and efficiency of quality and inspections systems
Plan, conduct, and supervise test and inspection of materials and products to ensure quality is maintained
Investigate customer complaints and non-conformance issues
Collect and compile statistical quality data
Analyze data to identify areas for improvement in the quality system
Develop, recommend, and monitor corrective and preventive actions
Prepare reports to communicate results of quality inspection activities to management	
Evaluate corrective actions
Monitor risk management activities	
Responsible for document management system
Navigated and worked in a warehouse

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for ensuring the product meets the established standards of quality including reliability,usability,and performance required for distribution to market.
Identify and resolve production issues.
Conduct product testing and corrections.
Create test cases.
Interpret and implement quality assurance standards.
Regression testing.
Used bug tracking program Jira.
Black Box Testing
API Testing
UAT Testing

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Game Tester
positions.description:
Responsible for finding and reporting bugs in games during the different stages of development of a video game.
 Keen observational abilities, along with good logical and analytical reasoning abilities.
Work closely with programmers and designers, to make sure critical bugs present in games are fixed before the gold disc is created. 
Regression testing.
Used bug tracking programs Jira and Test Track Pro
UI Testing 
Black Box Testing
API Testing
UAT Testing

positions.title: Operational Security Specialist
positions.description:
Daily use of Microsoft products which may include PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Word, etc.
Daily use of fax machines, printers, shredders, computers and any other office devices.
Taking incoming calls while sounding professional.
Process visitors in support of high visibility conferences and coordinate other visitor requirements in support of the facility's mission.

positions.title: Security Officer
positions.description:
Filed reports, monitored and patrolled designated areas. 
Registered record time of inspection trips at watch stations. 
Patrolled facility and manned post as instructed by security management.
Reported all incidents and accidents to proper authority.

positions.title: Security Guard
positions.description:
Ensured appropriate security on deck and maintained visibility of security officers in casino premises. 
Administered monetary transfers, provided escorts to transfer money from tokens and other cash related transaction. 
Assisted customers and resolved all queries associated with casino. 
Prepared detailed reports of all incidents related any violation of casino rule.

positions.title: Security Forces
positions.description:
E-4 Honorable Discharge

Developed plans, policies, procedures and detailed instructions for work related programs.
Planned organized and scheduled work related activities.
Supervised and trained new personnel.
Analyzed reports and statistics.
